nodes.label: IotAuditSession model (store_id, device_id, start/end time)
nodes.rationale: Each audit iteration is a discrete session; preserves history across interruptions without overwriting logs.

nodes.label: Fix Gallery Toolbar Select Types and Client Directive
nodes.norm_label: fix gallery toolbar select types and client directive

nodes.label: Base UI Select onValueChange null guard
nodes.norm_label: base ui select onvaluechange null guard
nodes.rationale: @base-ui/react Select emits string | null; handlers must handle null to satisfy types.

nodes.label: Separate / Dashboard and /monitoring routes
nodes.rationale: Executive summary vs store-by-store gallery, matching breadcrumbs and sidebar.

nodes.label: GPS location via store master coordinates
nodes.norm_label: gps location via store master coordinates
nodes.rationale: ESP32 portable hardware lacks GPS; location derived from active session store_id.

nodes.label: Hybrid Grid vs List View
nodes.rationale: Dense table for operations alongside visual card gallery; no reliance on store photos.

nodes.label: scrollbar-gutter: stable
nodes.rationale: Prevent horizontal layout shift when toggling Grid/List views.

nodes.label: Server-side debounced store search (300ms, LIMIT 25, pinned DEMO-HO)
nodes.norm_label: server-side debounced store search (300ms, limit 25, pinned demo-ho)
nodes.rationale: Avoid downloading 22,000+ stores to the browser.

nodes.label: store_id column on devices and history tables
nodes.norm_label: store_id column on devices and history tables
nodes.rationale: Non-destructive ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS (Option 1).

nodes.label: Session-scoped sensor display
nodes.rationale: Dummy sensors (e.g. L6) appear only in sessions that recorded them.

nodes.label: Floating pulsing pins without label box
nodes.norm_label: floating pulsing pins without label box

nodes.label: Leaflet + CartoDB Voyager tile map (ssr: false)
nodes.norm_label: leaflet + cartodb voyager tile map (ssr: false)
nodes.rationale: Natural light map recognizable as a standard map; dynamic import with ssr false for Next.js/React 19 compatibility.

nodes.label: Dynamic Sensor Naming and Session Scoping
nodes.norm_label: dynamic sensor naming and session scoping

nodes.label: 270-degree SVG Arc Gauge (strokeDasharray + feGaussianBlur glow)
nodes.rationale: Avoid heavy charting libraries like Recharts for gauges to keep rendering fast.

nodes.label: Dynamic sensor mapping from devices.sensors / history.phase_name
nodes.norm_label: dynamic sensor mapping from devices.sensors / history.phase_name
nodes.rationale: Remove hardcoded L12->L1 phase mapping; names follow the database.

nodes.label: In-memory LRU cache for telemetry queries
nodes.norm_label: in-memory lru cache for telemetry queries

nodes.label: Store code as URL slug (/monitoring/[storeCode])
nodes.rationale: Clean, human-readable URLs.

nodes.label: Multi-Device Store Aggregation
nodes.rationale: Group IoT devices sharing a store code (e.g. TI90) so active sessions on sub-devices are elevated to the store level instead of being masked by idle devices.

nodes.label: Sidebar Active Indicator and Modern Hover
nodes.norm_label: sidebar active indicator and modern hover

nodes.label: buttonVariants + next/link instead of Button asChild
nodes.norm_label: buttonvariants + next/link instead of button aschild
nodes.rationale: Base UI Button enforces native button semantics; shadcn recommends buttonVariants for links.

nodes.label: Hardcoded id-ID locale for deterministic SSR/CSR toLocaleString
nodes.norm_label: hardcoded id-id locale for deterministic ssr/csr tolocalestring
nodes.rationale: Server defaults to en-US while browser uses id-ID; fixing locale avoids hydration mismatch.

nodes.label: suppressHydrationWarning for next-themes / dynamic timestamps
nodes.rationale: Known next-themes script injection mismatch on body.

nodes.label: Emerald Active State Indicator + Modern Hover
nodes.norm_label: emerald active state indicator + modern hover
nodes.rationale: Route-aware usePathname matching with glowing emerald accent bar.

nodes.label: Definite Store Master Data Alignment (code, name, branch)
nodes.norm_label: definite store master data alignment (code, name, branch)
nodes.rationale: Drop variable audit assumption fields; align with definite master data.

nodes.label: Store Analytics Widget with Load Profile
nodes.norm_label: store analytics widget with load profile

nodes.label: Dashboard Time-Grain Switcher and Real Monthly History
nodes.norm_label: dashboard time-grain switcher and real monthly history

nodes.label: Real Recorded Data Only (No Synthetic Fill)
nodes.norm_label: real recorded data only (no synthetic fill)
nodes.rationale: Synthetic 2025/12-month dummy fills were stripped so the monthly tab reflects genuine recorded store data.

nodes.label: 7-day sliding window navigation (weekOffset, anchored at yesterday)
nodes.norm_label: 7-day sliding window navigation (weekoffset, anchored at yesterday)
nodes.rationale: Continuous time-series from telemetry + history CTE so past weeks have real data.

nodes.label: Client-side store swapping via lightweight API
nodes.norm_label: client-side store swapping via lightweight api
nodes.rationale: Instant store switching without full page reload.

nodes.label: Dual tab: 24h load profile vs 7-day kWh
nodes.norm_label: dual tab: 24h load profile vs 7-day kwh

nodes.label: Store-specific anchor (latestRecordedDate)
nodes.rationale: Historical stores anchor to last recorded audit date so charts are never empty.

nodes.label: Dynamic Equipment Naming from devices.sensors and history.phase_name
nodes.norm_label: dynamic equipment naming from devices.sensors and history.phase_name

nodes.label: PLN B2/TR Tariff (Rp 1.444,7/kWh)
nodes.rationale: Monthly default selection prevents cumulative lifetime values distorting monthly budgeting; history in a Sheet keeps dashboard context.

nodes.label: Aiven to Biznet VPS PostgreSQL Migration
nodes.norm_label: aiven to biznet vps postgresql migration
nodes.rationale: Pool renamed to TelemetryPool with getAivenPool alias for compatibility; legacy Aiven URL retained for future data migration tooling.

nodes.label: VPS Database Migration and Dynamic Equipment Monitoring
nodes.norm_label: vps database migration and dynamic equipment monitoring

nodes.label: Environment variable strictness for DB connections
nodes.norm_label: environment variable strictness for db connections
nodes.rationale: No hardcoded credential fallbacks; throw if SPARTA_DATABASE_URL or AIVEN_DATABASE_URL missing; resolves GitHub Push Protection.

nodes.label: Default Analytics to Latest Recorded Date
nodes.norm_label: default analytics to latest recorded date

nodes.label: Asia/Jakarta (WIB) Timezone Date Alignment
nodes.rationale: Converting epoch to Asia/Jakarta date in SQL prevents data after 00:00 WIB being misattributed to the previous UTC day.

nodes.label: Default to Latest Recorded Date (availableDates[0])
nodes.rationale: All analytics open on the newest recorded date, consistent with the Telemetry tab, with < > flashback navigation.

nodes.label: Dynamic todayJakarta Date Fallback
nodes.rationale: No static dates hardcoded; defaults come from availableDates[0] and fall back to current Asia/Jakarta date for newly onboarded empty stores.

nodes.label: Sync Logo and Branding with Sparta Energy
nodes.norm_label: sync logo and branding with sparta energy

nodes.label: Compact Interactive Sensor Metric Chips
nodes.rationale: Tall cards pushed down the main chart; two-line ~56px chips reduce vertical space for multi-sensor stores.

nodes.label: Multi-Select Phase Filtering with Total Daya Beban
nodes.norm_label: multi-select phase filtering with total daya beban

nodes.label: Time Range Modes (Harian, Bulanan, Tahunan, Sesi Audit)
nodes.norm_label: time range modes (harian, bulanan, tahunan, sesi audit)
nodes.rationale: Concise Indonesian labels; navigation shifts by day/month/year per mode.

nodes.label: Fix Weekly Chart Switching and Timezone Alignment
nodes.norm_label: fix weekly chart switching and timezone alignment

nodes.label: Store Detail Analytics Tabs and Time Range Modes
nodes.norm_label: store detail analytics tabs and time range modes

nodes.label: Human-Centric Equipment Names (Hide Channel IDs)
nodes.rationale: Long hardware channel tags like (PRODUCTION_01) bloated cards; full ID kept in title attribute for engineers.

nodes.label: Summary/KPI First, Time-Series Second Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Users see per-phase average/max before inspecting the large chart; card clicks still filter the chart.

nodes.label: Telemetry data presence dots in calendar
nodes.norm_label: telemetry data presence dots in calendar
nodes.rationale: Guide users to dates with real data.

nodes.label: Higher-contrast emerald week highlight in light mode
nodes.norm_label: higher-contrast emerald week highlight in light mode
nodes.rationale: 5% opacity was too faint against white popover.

nodes.label: raw_combined CTE for Phase Grouping
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL disallows aggregates in GROUP BY; normalize phase in a CTE and group by phase on the outer query.

nodes.label: Fix Weekly Energy kWh Calculation and Telemetry Integration
nodes.norm_label: fix weekly energy kwh calculation and telemetry integration

nodes.label: Normalize Phase Mapping to Eliminate Weekly Chart Disparity
nodes.norm_label: normalize phase mapping to eliminate weekly chart disparity

nodes.label: Fix GROUP BY Aggregate Function Error in Sensor Query
nodes.norm_label: fix group by aggregate function error in sensor query

nodes.label: Per-Phase Energy Delta Before Summing
nodes.rationale: Grouping by phase before MAX(energy)-MIN(energy) prevents cross-phase counter offsets from producing false multi-hundred kWh spikes.

nodes.label: Phase Identifier Normalization (L12/L1/R to R, etc.)
nodes.norm_label: phase identifier normalization (l12/l1/r to r, etc.)
nodes.rationale: Mapping legacy L12/L13/L14 and L1/L2/L3 to R/S/T preserves continuity across the August 28 MQTT topic migration, avoiding drops and split curves.

nodes.label: Telemetry and History Stream Union
nodes.rationale: Union history with telemetry so dates without manual capture sessions still show continuous background telemetry; filters phase != L6 and non-dummy rows.

nodes.label: Dokploy Webhook CI/CD Deploy
nodes.rationale: Webhook secret reference renamed to DOKPLOY_WEBHOOK for consistency across sparta-energy, Smart-Energy-Meter-Vps and smart-energy-monitoring.

nodes.label: GHCR Lowercase Image Naming
nodes.rationale: Lowercasing GITHUB_REPOSITORY prevents GHCR push failures when repo names contain uppercase characters.

nodes.label: Store IoT Status Model (LIVE / HISTORICAL / UNASSIGNED)
nodes.norm_label: store iot status model (live / historical / unassigned)
nodes.rationale: LIVE when device online and recording; HISTORICAL when history rows exist; UNASSIGNED otherwise.

nodes.label: AdminShell Collapsible Sidebar Layout
nodes.rationale: Identical to SPARTA Energy admin dashboard so both apps feel like one integrated system.

nodes.label: CircularGauge SVG Arc Component
nodes.rationale: Lightweight custom 270-degree SVG arc, no extra library.

nodes.label: lib/mock-data.ts (MOCK_STORES, getMockStore, getMockTelemetry)
nodes.rationale: Static mock data with API-ready types to be swapped for real API in Tahap 2.

nodes.label: GHCR-to-Dokploy Deployment
nodes.rationale: Dokploy owns routing, HTTPS, ports and VPS limits; image listens on 3000 with HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0.

nodes.norm_label: project governance and deployment template design

nodes.label: /impeccable init Requirement
nodes.rationale: Run when PRODUCT.md or DESIGN.md missing so UI work has product/design context.

nodes.label: Pre-commit Task-Note Guard (.githooks/pre-commit)
nodes.rationale: Blocks commits staging substantive changes without a dated task note; hook changes also require a note so the guard cannot be silently weakened.

nodes.label: Required Dated Task Note Contract
nodes.rationale: Durable record of every substantive change; named YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-<task>.md in Asia/Jakarta time; no secrets or production data.

nodes.label: Impeccable Skill Required for UI Work
nodes.norm_label: impeccable skill required for ui work

nodes.label: No Manual Spacing on shadcn Components
nodes.norm_label: no manual spacing on shadcn components
nodes.rationale: Preserve calibrated component spacing; use layout wrappers like flex gap-4.

nodes.label: git commit --no-verify Prohibition
nodes.rationale: Bypasses the mandatory task-note guard.

nodes.label: Prisma and Database Safety Rules
nodes.rationale: Prohibit db push / migrate dev / migrate deploy; ask dev vs prod before DB-affecting commands; only validate/generate permitted.

nodes.label: Prioritize shadcn/ui Components
nodes.rationale: Avoid rebuilding components that shadcn provides; custom only when none fits.

nodes.label: Dual Database Strategy
nodes.rationale: Isolate millions of raw telemetry rows from transactional business data in separate logical PostgreSQL databases.

nodes.label: Parallel Query & In-Memory Cache (Promise.all)
nodes.rationale: getAuditSessions, getTelemetryHistory, getStoreAnalyticsData run in parallel with cache for instant responsiveness.

nodes.label: Clean Light Mode Visual Direction (#2c7a57 accent)
nodes.norm_label: clean light mode visual direction (#2c7a57 accent)
nodes.rationale: Evolves beyond myECO layout to SPARTA premium standard; CSS variables allow future dark mode.

nodes.label: Base UI render prop instead of Radix asChild
nodes.norm_label: base ui render prop instead of radix aschild
nodes.rationale: shadcn base-nova style uses @base-ui/react, which exposes render prop rather than asChild.

nodes.label: SPARTA Energy Emerald Brand Color (oklch 0.42 0.12 163)
nodes.rationale: Replace base-nova purple/blue primary with the requested emerald accent across :root and .dark.

nodes.label: Ignore Scratch Files and Update Gitignore
nodes.norm_label: ignore scratch files and update gitignore

nodes.label: Remove automatic copy-assets from dev/build
nodes.rationale: Assets already present in public/assets; keep copy:assets for manual sync only.

nodes.label: Dual-Database Architecture (sparta_energy + energy_meter)
nodes.rationale: Separate transactional business data from high-volume IoT telemetry to prevent bloat and isolate services.

nodes.label: Fix Energy Meter Reset Rollover False Spike
nodes.norm_label: fix energy meter reset rollover false spike

nodes.label: Interval Delta Energy (Delta kWh)
nodes.rationale: Charts show consumption per time bucket (GREATEST(0, MAX-MIN)) so users see spikes vs idle periods instead of a monotonic odometer.

nodes.label: Physics-Based Power-Bounded Energy Guard
nodes.rationale: If MAX-MIN energy exceeds what average power allows in the interval, a PZEM counter reset/rollover is assumed and P_avg x dt is used, eliminating false spikes (e.g. 105.79 kWh on DC Cianjur).

nodes.label: Tiered time aggregation (Day=1h, Week=1d, Session=15min paginated)
nodes.norm_label: tiered time aggregation (day=1h, week=1d, session=15min paginated)
nodes.rationale: Keep navigation of hundreds of thousands of points fast; default to latest data.
